product: Sleek Academia provides coaching, study systems, and class help for working online college students in the US and UK.
audience: Working online college students in the US and UK
pricing: Alpha: $25 per month; $50 for a full 8-week class
Beta: $100 per month; $200 for a full 8-week class
Romeo: $300 per month; $600 for a full 8-week class
study_plan: Students add a class name, school, and syllabus to make a week-by-week schedule. The free plan holds one class.
ai_guidance: Use AI to clarify, plan, practice, and check understanding. Students draft from their own notes and readings.
limits: Students remain responsible for their own coursework, submissions, and exams.
Sleek Academia does not do graded work for students.
